# Inori Kids

> Inori Kids (inorikids.com) is an Indian company partnered with Chungwoo Funstation of South Korea (with sister companies Spacetalk and Ittang), bringing world-class kids play areas, landscape and recreational solutions from Korea to India. It designs, imports, installs and guarantees kids play areas, playground equipment, kids indoor play areas, landscape furniture (pergolas, pavilions, benches, public art), kids furniture and outdoor gym equipment for residential developers, housing societies, schools, malls and hotels in India. A design-led solution provider: clients give the space, Inori Kids designs the solution around it. Based in Gurugram, Haryana, India. Projects across India.

Contact: Amol Sarin +91 96504 41666 · Hosung Yoo +91 78880 02985 · Email hello@inorikids.com ·  Instagram https://www.instagram.com/i_norikids/ · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/inorikids/

## Solutions
- [Kids Play Area & Outdoor Playground Equipment | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/outdoor-play-areas): Kids play areas and playground equipment for societies, schools and parks in India: play towers, slides, swings, climbing nets, themed play and safety surfacing. Korean-made, installed and guaranteed.
- [Kids Indoor Play Area & Indoor Play Solutions | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/indoor-play-areas): Kids indoor play areas for malls, clubhouses, play cafés, hotels and preschools in India: net towers, tube slides, soft play and themed interiors. Korean design, installed and guaranteed in India.
- [Landscape Furniture, Pergolas & Pavilions in India | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/landscape-furniture): Landscape furniture for developers, campuses and parks in India: pavilions, tea houses, pergolas, benches, shelters, smart street furniture and public art. Award-winning Korean design.
- [Outdoor Gym Equipment for Societies & Parks | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/outdoor-gym-equipment): Outdoor gym and open gym equipment for housing societies, parks and campuses in India: strength, cardio, calisthenics and senior fitness stations. Korean design, installed in India.
- [Kids Furniture for Preschools & Kids Rooms | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/kids-furniture): KC-certified Korean birch plywood kids furniture: preschool tables and storage, play kitchens, climbing beds and kids room furniture for preschools, clubhouses and play cafés in India.
- [Custom Playground Design & Themed Play Structures | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/custom-playground-design): Bespoke playground and pavilion design in India: one-of-a-kind sculptural play structures designed, engineered and made in Korea, installed by Inori Kids.
- [Kids Play Area Guides for Developers & Schools | Inori Kids](https://inorikids.com/guides): Practical guides on planning kids play areas, indoor play, landscape furniture and outdoor gyms in India, for developers, contractors, schools and architects.

## Key facts
- Awards for the designs: Red Dot (2024 winner; Best of the Best 2012), iF Product Design Award, Asia Design Prize, Presidential Award (Korea, 2019), 20 Good Design Awards
- Safety: EN 1176 and ASTM certifications; KC certification for children's products
- Made in Korea in partner factories; design, installation, safety surfacing, warranty and after-sales in India by Inori Kids
